title: Managed Backup: overage treatment
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines overage treatment.

## Tier basis

**Overage treatment.** Treatment of usage exceeding included allowance; string.

| Contract tier | Overage treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Billing of actual usage |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Billing of actual usage |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Billing of actual usage |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Billing of actual usage |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Billing of actual usage |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Billing of actual usage |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, overage treatment is Billing of actual usage.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, overage treatment stays the same.
